svg.title: GitHub Workflows Architecture
svg.desc: Four GitHub Actions workflows — CI, Security, CT, and CD — showing triggers, jobs, dependencies, and inter-workflow connections.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What branches trigger the CI and Security workflows?')
sendPrompt('What does the monthly and weekly schedule trigger?')
sendPrompt('What path triggers the Continuous Training pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What linting and testing runs for the AI microservice?')
sendPrompt('What runs for the Django backend in CI?')
sendPrompt('What runs for the React frontend in CI?')
sendPrompt('What runs for the Rust Export Middleman in CI?')
sendPrompt('How does the workflow install the ArgoCD CLI?')
sendPrompt('What secrets are used to log in to ArgoCD?')
sendPrompt('Which ArgoCD app gets synced in the CD workflow?')
sendPrompt('How long does ArgoCD wait for the app to be healthy?')
sendPrompt('What is the final deployment outcome?')
sendPrompt('Why does the CT workflow need Git LFS?')
sendPrompt('What Python deps are installed for CT?')
sendPrompt('What test runs before retraining?')
sendPrompt('What does python main.py do in the training pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does the CT workflow verify model improvement?')
sendPrompt('What files are committed after retraining?')
sendPrompt('What tools scan for leaked secrets?')
sendPrompt('What languages does CodeQL scan?')
sendPrompt('What dependency scanners run for each language?')
sendPrompt('What code quality tools run in the security workflow?')
sendPrompt('Which Docker images get built and scanned?')
sendPrompt('What is the SBOM and why is it generated?')
